_comment: Two custom function tools for the Vapi assistant. Create each in the Vapi dashboard (Tools), or attach via the API. For BOTH tools set server.url to your public webhook (https://<ngrok-domain>/vapi/webhook) and add the custom header 'x-vapi-secret: <VAPI_SECRET>' so the backend accepts the call. The backend dispatches by tool name and returns { results: [{ toolCallId, result }] }.

function.name: lookupPatientByPhone
function.description: Check whether a patient already exists for a given US phone number. Call this as soon as you have collected the caller's phone number, to detect returning patients. Returns found=true with the patient's name and patient_id if a match exists.

phone_number.description: The caller's US phone number (digits; formatting is fine).

function.name: savePatient
function.description: Create a new patient record, or update an existing one, after the caller has confirmed their information. Use mode='create' for a new patient, or mode='update' with the patient_id from lookupPatientByPhone for a returning caller. Returns success=true with patient_id, or success=false with an 'errors' list describing which fields to re-collect.

mode.description: create for a new patient; update for a returning caller.

patient_id.description: Required only when mode='update': the patient_id returned by lookupPatientByPhone.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format. Must be a real date, not in the future.

sex.description: One of the four allowed values.

phone_number.description: US 10-digit phone number (digits; formatting is fine).

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional emergency contact US phone number.
